info.title: bimwright — Revit MCP server (bimwright.dev
info.description: MCP gateway for Autodesk Revit 2022-2027 — expose the Revit API as AI-callable tools with progressive disclosure (toolset gating), a Transaction-safe batch_execute, and a ToolBaker self-evolution engine. Pair with the Revit plugin distributed on GitHub Releases.

options.name: --http
options.description: Run HTTP SSE on 127.0.0.1:<port> (1-65535). Default = stdio.

options.name: --toolsets
options.description: Comma list of toolsets to enable. Default: query,create,view,meta.

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Shortcut that excludes create, modify, and delete toolsets.
